resources.string: Lets RemoteScroll perform swipes and taps on the screen when you press buttons on your Bluetooth media remote, so you can scroll videos without touching the screen, find TikTok\'s Save button, and automatically click Skip Ad on YouTube ads. It never stores or sends anything.

1. Enable the accessibility service.
2. Start the remote service.
3. Open TikTok, YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels and use your Bluetooth remote:

• Next: next video (swipe up)
• Previous: previous video (swipe down)
• Hold Next: volume up
• Hold Previous: volume down
• Play/Pause: pause/resume
• Hold Play/Pause: 1 beep = like, 2 beeps = pocket lock on/off, 3 beeps = save. Let go after the beeps you want.
• Or, in Press count style: 2 presses = like, 3 = pocket lock, 4 = save, hold = pocket lock (or like or save, your choice).

Pocket lock: the screen goes black and ignores touches, but TikTok keeps playing and your remote keeps working. Put the phone in your pocket or face down. To unlock, hold a finger on the screen for 2 seconds, or use the pocket lock action on the remote (2 beeps).

Do not press the power button: a real lock pauses TikTok and Android blocks remote control behind the lock screen.
Shown while RemoteScroll is listening for media buttons

🔒 Pocket lock

Remote still controls the video
Hold screen 2 s, or use the remote
(2 beeps = pocket lock), to unlock
Everything works: scroll, pause, like, save, pocket lock.
Scroll, pause, like and pocket lock work. Save only works if a Save button is on screen. YouTube Auto-Skip Ads works on both regular YouTube videos and Shorts.
Scroll, like and pocket lock work. A tap mutes or unmutes in Reels instead of pausing. Save only works if a Save button is on screen.
Start the remote automatically when TikTok opens
No need to press Start: opening TikTok (or YouTube / Instagram) turns the remote on. If you press Stop, it stays off until you start it again or restart the phone.
Start when a chosen remote connects
When %1$s connects over Bluetooth, the remote service starts and the video app opens. When it disconnects, the remote stops and pocket lock goes off.
Choose your remote under Remotes first. Auto-start only reacts to the remotes you chose.
Pocket lock in pocket or face down
Uses the proximity sensor while the remote service runs. Pocket lock turns on after 1.5 s covered, and off again when you take the phone out.
This phone has no proximity sensor.
Pocket lock turns on automatically after this many remote scrolls. Touching the screen resets the count back to 0.
When time is up, pocket lock goes off, TikTok pauses and the remote stops.
Stops at %1$s. Pocket lock goes off, TikTok pauses and the remote stops.
Any Bluetooth device can control TikTok.
\n\nWorks for remotes that connect as a Bluetooth keyboard. Presses from other remotes can\'t be told apart and always work.
No paired Bluetooth devices found. Pair your remote in Bluetooth settings first.
RemoteScroll needs the Nearby devices permission to list your Bluetooth devices.
Catches remote keys before other apps see them. Turn it on if your remote does nothing with it off.
Press Play/Pause quickly 2, 3 or 4 times. You hear 1, 2, 3 beeps as the presses are counted. 4 presses save straight away. Use this if long holds don\'t work with your remote.
The action runs once the remote is quiet this long. 1 press (pause) waits this long too.
Hold Play/Pause this long for the action above. Keep it under 1.5 s: some remotes (like SUKOU) end every hold at about 1.5 s.
Hold Play/Pause and listen: 1 beep, 2 beeps, 3 beeps. Let go after the beeps you want. A short press pauses. Some remotes end every hold at about 1.5 s; for those, use Press count.
With this screen open (and the remote service running), press buttons on your remote. Each press is listed here with the time since the previous one. Nothing is tapped while this screen is open.
Enable the RemoteScroll accessibility service first

Shows a floating quick controller over TikTok with instant Pocket Lock, auto-lock setup, and scroll shortcuts.
Keeps the floating quick control on screen across all apps so it never hides unexpectedly.
Mini controller hidden. Open TikTok or RemoteScroll to restore.
Auto-skip feed ads & LIVE streams (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)
Scans short-video feed tags and automatically swipes past sponsored ads, promotions, and LIVE broadcasts in under 0.5s.
Automatically skips YouTube video ads as soon as the countdown finishes, closes in-player ad banners, and swipes past YouTube Shorts ads — even under Pocket Lock or Sleep Blackout Mode.
Clicks Skip / Skip Ad automatically across portrait, fullscreen, and Shorts without touching your phone.
Mute audio during YouTube ad countdown
Clicks Skip ad in Facebook videos and swipes past Sponsored reels. Sponsored posts in the News Feed are left alone.
Silences media volume while waiting out the 5s skip countdown or unskippable ads, then restores your volume automatically.
If you fall asleep (no remote button pressed or screen touched for this long), TikTok closes and the screen locks.
Drag visual markers directly on your screen to set the exact swipe path for Next/Back and tap points.
Floating Next & Back buttons on screen
Adds draggable Next (▼) and Back (▲) buttons directly on your screen for quick thumb tapping.

Keeps video audio playing smoothly in the foreground while completely turning off the screen (100% true pitch black with 0% OLED light emission and lowest backlight). Perfect for listening in bed to stories, podcasts, interviews, or ASMR without draining battery or straining your eyes.
Swipe Up/Down on the black screen to change videos in bed; Double-tap anywhere to wake; Single-tap for dim clock & battery HUD.
Automatically advances to the next video after your chosen timer. Shows a live countdown badge on screen. Manually swiping or pressing remote resets the timer back to full.
Restarts the timer whenever you manually swipe or press Next/Back on your remote so new videos aren\'t cut short.
Displays a draggable Khmer subtitle overlay on top of YouTube (works with Live Audio Capture, YouTube CC, or Live Caption).
Reads translated Khmer sentences aloud automatically using Khmer TTS while gently ducking video volume.
Displays the heard source text above the Khmer translation so you can follow along.
Automatically pauses subtitle overlay when you leave YouTube or RemoteScroll.
